title: Minimum Early Termination Fee by Site Size: Small Business Electricity Supply
content:
For the early termination fee on a Small Business Electricity Supply agreement, the minimum fee follows the size of the site, measured by its energy spend: the energy lines posted on the agreement in the 12 months before the handling date are added up in dollars; under 3000 dollars sets the minimum fee at 100.00 dollars; at least 3000 but under 6000 dollars sets it at 125.00 dollars; 6000 dollars or more keeps the plan's minimum fee.

**What is added up?**
The dollar amounts of the agreement's energy charge lines only, not its service fee, sales tax, fee or credit lines; a line falls in those 12 months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posted date from the handling date.

**What minimum fee does each size of site carry?**
Under 3000 USD of energy charges: 100.00 USD. From 3000 USD to under 6000 USD: 125.00 USD. 6000 USD or more: the plan's minimum fee.

**Where are the edges?**
Hypothetical totals: 2999.99 USD carries 100.00 USD and 3000.00 USD carries 125.00 USD; 5999.99 USD carries 125.00 USD and 6000.00 USD carries the plan's minimum fee.
